{{Quote|As I found myself alone again, I saw the clouds beginning to gather overhead. It was too symbolic for my taste: the calm before the storm, the calm before the people here hunted the chiilaks into extinction.|Excerpt from Jio Gihal's journal|<ref name="CotG" />}}
'''Misnor''' was a [[Temperature/Legends|frigid]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] with [[Water/Legends|frozen]] [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] and glacial regions. [[Chiilak/Legends|Chiilaks]] were native to Misnor, and were hunted for their fur.

==Description==
{{Quote|A wind was starting to blow in from the ocean, and it was clear that a bad storm would be coming in by nightfall. I would have to return to the hunting village.|Excerpt from Jio Gihal's journal|<ref name="CotG" />}}
Misnor was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] with glacial regions that included frigid seas and [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]], such as the [[North Berr Sea]]. Storms were known to gather over the oceans. Its northernmost regions were lightly populated, though the rest of the world remained largely unexplored. The [[Diet/Legends|omnivorous]] [[Chiilak/Legends|chiilaks]] were native to this moon, and were sought by hunters for their furred skin, which was used to make garments like coats and cloaks. The deep, frigid waters inhabited by the chiilaks were also home to [[Fish/Legends|fish]] and marine plants, while a number of bushes, grasses, and berries thrived on the frozen surface regions.<ref name="CotG" />

==History==
{{Quote|The area was thick with hunting skiffs, all of them searching for the few remaining chiilaks in the North Berr Sea.|Excerpt from Jio Gihal's journal|<ref name="CotG" />}}
Misnor was colonized by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and other [[Species/Legends|species]]. These settlers soon became a danger to the native chiilaks, who initially fled from them for safety but later began attacking Humans and common species. The few permanent communities in chiilak areas were mostly hunting villages, some of which constructed barriers and posted guards to fend off attacks.<ref name="CotG" />

Uncontrolled hunting was rife on Misnor, with hunters using hunting [[Skiff/Legends|skiffs]], [[aquatic breather]]s, and other diving gear to pursue them in the frozen oceans. Many [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologists]] lobbied [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Yettaw]] to restrict or ban chiilak hunting, but the governor labeled the creatures a "menace" and sided with the [[Misnor garment manufacturers' association|local garment manufacturers' association]], which derived great profit from chiilak fur. Continued hunting reduced the chiilak population from an estimated 100 million to only 3 million in a span of 25 [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="CotG" />

The xenobiologist [[Jio Gihal]] spent [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] searching for chiilaks on Misnor, in order to study their migration and living habits for a [[Misnor tourist office|local tourist office]]. After [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] of searching, Gihal observed three young chiilaks feeding on teloberry bushes, and had a close encounter with an adult as it warned the youngsters. The chiilaks dove into the water before a hunting skiff arrived, and Gihal denied seeing any chiilaks when asked by the [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. Once the captain departed, Gihal again spotted the adult chiilak, which stared at him before returning to the water. Gihal later wrote about the experience in a journal, and believed the hunters would eventually hunt the chiilaks into extinction.<ref name="CotG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Misnor was first mentioned in the [[1994]] [[West End Games]] roleplaying supplement ''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''. The celestial body was initially introduced as a moon, but is referred to as a "planet" and "world" later in the text.<ref name="CotG" />
